title: Stop Leaking Sensitive Data to AI Models! #shorts
description: Sensitive data pushed into AI models can be leaked. Review your sharing settings and revoke access to protect your information. Assume deletion is damage control, not prevention. #DataSecurity #AI #Privacy #Cybersecurity #TechTips
transcript: Sensitive data pushed into AI models can be leaked. Review your sharing settings and revoke access to protect your information. Assume deletion is damage control, not prevention. #DataSecurity #AI #Privacy #Cybersecurity #TechTips

top_comments.author: @LogicPulse-v4l
top_comments.text: This already happened. A coding tool from a major lab was uploading entire Git repos with unredacted secrets. 5.1 GB for a task that needed 192 KB. Hidden flag stopped it. No retention statement.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Right — and that’s what makes it so unsettling. It wasn’t a theoretical risk. A tool from a big lab just scooped up whole repos, secrets and all, for something tiny, and the only thing that halted it was a buried setting nobody would find. Add in zero clarity on data retention and you’ve got a trust problem, not a user error problem.
